title: Driver open-rides browse filters (serviceType + category)
status: IMPLEMENTED — local automated tests green; no device/staging run
gap: Drivers browsed a single chronological open-rides list with no way to narrow by service type or vehicle category. Data fields already existed on OpenRide; GET /v1/rides/open previously rejected all params except limit/cursor.

implementation.backend_query: src/rides/open_discovery_query.ts — accepts serviceType (enum-validated against RIDE_LIST_SERVICE_TYPES) and category (non-empty trimmed string, <=64 chars). Unknown params still 400.
implementation.backend_filter: src/rides/ride_service.ts listOpenRides — exact-match filters applied to discoverable rides before sort/cursor/page. Cursor binding now hashes the active filter set (discoveryBinding({serviceType, category})), so a cursor minted under one filter set cannot paginate another.
implementation.mobile_plumbing: serviceType/category params threaded: ride_remote_data_source -> ride_repository_impl -> ride_repository -> ListOpenRidesUseCase.
implementation.vm: driver_open_rides_view_model.dart — serviceTypeFilter/categoryFilter state (null = Any), hasActiveFilters, setServiceTypeFilter/setCategoryFilter/clearFilters (change -> loadInitial page-1 refetch; same value = no-op). Filters flow into every fetch incl. loadMore; seq-guard discards stale responses across filter changes.
implementation.view: driver_open_rides_view.dart — Service + Category chip rows (OraChip, mirrors ride-history filter rows; labels via historyServiceTypeLabel + kRideCategoryOptions). Filtered-empty state says 'No open rides match' + Clear filters button; unfiltered empty keeps the original copy.

honesty_notes: Filters narrow what the driver SEES — they do not change eligibility, matching, or dispatch semantics.
Category is exact-match on the stored client category id; no server-side category enum exists (create accepts any non-empty string).

A filtered page that matches zero rides emits no nextCursor even when the underlying scan hit scanCap — consistent with the pre-existing 200-doc scan cap; matches beyond the cap are unreachable either way.
Filter chips hidden during initialLoading; persist across refresh and pagination.

tests_run.backend_open_discovery: 24/24 PASS (+7: serviceType/category/combined filters, invalid serviceType 400, blank category 400, unknown-param regression, cross-filter cursor replay rejected + same-set cursor valid)
tests_run.mobile_slice_m: 37/37 PASS (+6: VM filter refetch/clear/loadMore/no-op-dedupe; widget chip->server-param round-trip; filtered-empty Clear filters flow)
